project.name: Citra
project.summary: Citra — local-first PDF evidence Instrument for agents (SDK/CLI/MCP). Brand package @sylphx/citra.

goals: Own the public MCP tool schemas and sole-Rust production runtime for local PDF document intelligence.
Preserve page and region provenance so agents can cite and verify evidence.
Keep processing local-first by default with explicit optional remote provider adapters.
Ship reproducible package release and host-install evidence for the npm + native binary surface.
nonGoals: Sylphx Platform Auth, Billing, Storage, Durable Work, Gateway, or hosted multi-tenant execution.
Spiron, Cubeage, or customer-specific product semantics.
Direct provider secrets or product-specific model routing inside this package.

owns.name: Document intelligence MCP contract
owns.description: Public MCP tools, schemas, package API, install surface, compatibility docs, and regression tests.

owns.name: Local document processing engine
owns.description: Pure-Rust PDF core and MCP server binary, provenance, optional OCR/vision adapters, benchmarks, and release evidence.

doesNotOwn: Sylphx Platform Durable Work, Auth, Billing, Storage, Gateway, hosted multi-tenant execution, customer accounts, or production data retention.
Gateway model-facing manifests, tenant policy, hosted execution, or billing surfaces around registered tools.
Spiron, Cubeage, or customer-specific permissions, audit, durable outcomes, or product semantics.

publicSurfaces.name: CI and release workflows
publicSurfaces.description: Code quality, package smoke, native packaging, and Changesets release.

allowedDependencies.surface: devDependencies for packaging, tests, and docs build only
Rust runtime dependencies for pdf-reader-core and mcp-server

forbiddenCouplings: Do not upload customer documents or call remote providers unless the caller explicitly selects a provider adapter that requires it.
Do not add hosted auth, billing, storage, tenancy, retention, durable work, or customer-account state inside this package.
Do not add direct provider secrets, Sylphx AI Gateway credentials, or product-specific model routing.
Do not treat residual TypeScript PDF engines under src/ as production authority.
Do not load Doctrine, Mission Control, or GroundAtlas as current instruction or live-state authority.
Do not publish packages from a human shell or personal token.

gaps.description: Residual TypeScript PDF handlers and legacy dist artifacts remain in the tree for oracle/differential work and must not be treated as production authority.
gaps.exitCondition: Oracle-only residual is isolated or deleted; public schema SSOT is crates-only; package and agent docs name Rust as sole production path.

gaps.description: npm product version (4.x) and Cargo workspace version (3.x) are not identical across ecosystems.
gaps.exitCondition: Documented mapping is machine-readable, or versions are aligned under one product identity policy.

gaps.description: Default-branch CI must remain green for frozen lockfile install and Validate Code Quality.
gaps.exitCondition: Consecutive main pushes show successful Validate Code Quality for the same SHA.

delivery.terminalBoundary: Exact package version published to npm for @sylphx/pdf-reader-mcp plus matching optional native platform packages, with registry readback after publish. No hosted application deploy terminal.

guardrails: Hosted document intelligence, enterprise packaging, or pricing changes require a separate service ADR/spec and commercial controls.
Commercial decisions must not move hosted auth, billing, storage, retention, or provider secrets into this local MCP package.

gaps.description: Doctrine and GroundAtlas package dogfood are retired lineage; residual adapter files must not reappear as machine truth.
gaps.exitCondition: No .doctrine machine-truth file; agents load Skills + project.manifest.json + PROJECT.md only.
